name: What is the difference between an aging-in-place remodel and a standard bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an aging-in-place remodel and a standard bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom remodel often prioritizes aesthetics, property value, and general functionality. An aging-in-place remodel, while also considering aesthetics, primarily focuses on enhanced safety, accessibility, and long-term independence for individuals with evolving mobility needs. This involves specific design choices like zero-threshold showers, grab bars, and wider clearances that might not be standard in a typical renovation. The emphasis is on proactive prevention and comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Aging-in-place remodels prioritize safety, accessibility, and long-term independence with features like zero-threshold showers, whereas standard remodels focus more on aesthetics and general updates.
